title: Roast Pepper-Veggie Ground Patties with Carrot, Cucumber & Dill Salad

steps.text: Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers. Divide between two medium bowls. (Set one bowl aside for the salad.)

Add veggie ground, bread crumbs, eggs, salt, and pepper to the first bowl with the peppers. Use your hands to combine the veggie ground mixture. Using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the mixture into ½-inch thick patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add patties and cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the second bowl with the peppers.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons.
Add carrots, almonds, and vinaigrette to the bowl, then stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide patties and salad between plates. Enjoy!
